name: Omnitech Engineering Limited
summary: Omnitech Engineering Limited, founded in 2006 and based in Rajkot, makes and supplies engineered components and assemblies worldwide, such as slips, mandrels, couplings, cylinders, shafts, drill bits, flanges and fittings. Its customers include the energy, motion control, oil and gas, power, valve, agriculture, earth moving and hydraulic industries.
